params.name: Dragonfly 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/dragonfly-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Dragonfly fifty years on, after the EHang EH216-S: a two-seat pod with a bubble windscreen, gull-wing doors and a skylight, no main rotor, four carbon arms in an X off a roof hub each carrying a finned coaxial motor pair (eight rotors), a louvred battery pack under the floor, a segmented tail kept only for the name, and faired skids. A variant of the heli mesh, worn as the Dragonfly 2076 factory edition.
